The '''Cadinth system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cadinth]].
